propositions: run() constructs ProviderSession outside the try/finally guard, so exceptions raised before the guard (e.g. from _check_tool_capability) leak an opened httpx client.
run() should wrap provider resolution through the call and teardown in a `with ProviderSession(cfg)` block and drop the now-redundant finally close.
The assert_gated fail-closed security check must execute before any provider client is constructed.
The _NoBuildProviderSession test stub must gain __enter__/__exit__ so the context-manager call site does not break it at runtime.
A close that raises must be logged and never propagated, preserving best-effort teardown semantics inside close().
The happy path must close the session exactly once, avoiding a double-close from a leftover finally.
